name: Mr. Mime
description: It is adept at conning people. It is said to be able to create walls out of thin air by miming.

moves.name: Barrier
moves.description: The user creates a sturdy wall that sharply raises its DEFENSE stat.

moves.name: Confusion
moves.description: A weak telekinetic attack that may also leave the foe confused.

moves.name: Substitute
moves.description: The user creates a decoy using one- quarter of its full HP.

moves.name: Meditate
moves.description: The user meditates to awaken its power and raise its ATTACK stat.

moves.name: Double Slap
moves.description: The foe is slapped repeatedly, back and forth, two to five times.

moves.name: Light Screen
moves.description: A wall of light cuts damage from SP. ATK attacks for five turns.

moves.name: Reflect
moves.description: A wall of light cuts damage from physical attacks for five turns.

moves.name: Magical Leaf
moves.description: The foe is attacked with a strange leaf that cannot be evaded.

moves.name: Encore
moves.description: Makes the foe use the move it last used repeatedly for two to six turns.

moves.name: Psybeam
moves.description: A peculiar ray is shot at the foe. It may leave the foe confused.

moves.name: Recycle
moves.description: A move that recycles a used item for use once more.

moves.name: Trick
moves.description: A move that tricks the foe into trading held items with the user.

moves.name: Role Play
moves.description: The user mimics the foe completely and copies the foe’s ability.

moves.name: Psychic
moves.description: A strong telekinetic attack. It may also lower the foe’s SP. DEF stat.

moves.name: Baton Pass
moves.description: The user switches out, passing along any stat changes to the new battler.

moves.name: Safeguard
moves.description: It protects the user’s party from all status problems for five turns.

moves.name: Hyper Beam
moves.description: A severely damaging attack that makes the user rest on the next turn.

moves.name: Solar Beam
moves.description: A 2-turn move that blasts the foe with absorbed energy in the 2nd turn.

moves.name: Thunderbolt
moves.description: A strong electrical attack that may also leave the foe paralyzed.

moves.name: Thunder
moves.description: A brutal lightning attack that may also leave the foe paralyzed.

moves.name: Toxic
moves.description: A move that badly poisons the foe. Its poison damage worsens every turn.

moves.name: Psychic
moves.description: A strong telekinetic attack. It may also lower the foe’s SP. DEF stat.

moves.name: Double Team
moves.description: The user creates illusory copies of itself to raise its evasiveness.

moves.name: Light Screen
moves.description: A wall of light cuts damage from SP. ATK attacks for five turns.

moves.name: Reflect
moves.description: A wall of light cuts damage from physical attacks for five turns.

moves.name: Flash
moves.description: A blast of light that cuts the foe’s accuracy. It also illuminates caves.

moves.name: Rest
moves.description: The user sleeps for two turns to fully restore HP and heal any status problem.

moves.name: Thief
moves.description: An attack that may take the foe’s held item if the user isn’t holding one.

moves.name: Protect
moves.description: Enables the user to evade all attacks. It may fail if used in succession.

moves.name: Attract
moves.description: If it is the other gender, the foe is made infatuated and unlikely to attack.

moves.name: Return
moves.description: This attack move grows more powerful the more the user likes its TRAINER.

moves.name: Frustration
moves.description: This attack move grows more powerful the less the user likes its TRAINER.

moves.name: Safeguard
moves.description: It protects the user’s party from all status problems for five turns.

moves.name: Hidden Power
moves.description: An attack that varies in type and intensity depending on the user.

moves.name: Rain Dance
moves.description: A heavy rain falls for five turns, powering up WATER- type moves.

moves.name: Sunny Day
moves.description: The sun blazes for five turns, powering up FIRE-type moves.

moves.name: Shadow Ball
moves.description: A shadowy blob is hurled at the foe. May also lower the foe’s SP. DEF.

moves.name: Torment
moves.description: It enrages the foe, making it incapable of using the same move successively.

moves.name: Facade
moves.description: An attack that is boosted if user is burned, poisoned, or paralyzed.

moves.name: Focus Punch
moves.description: An attack that is executed last. The user flinches if hit beforehand.

moves.name: Taunt
moves.description: The foe is taunted into a rage that allows it to use only attack moves.

moves.name: Brick Break
moves.description: An attack that also breaks any barrier like LIGHT SCREEN and REFLECT.

moves.name: Skill Swap
moves.description: The user employs its psychic power to swap abilities with the foe.

moves.name: Snatch
moves.description: Steals the effects of the foe’s healing or status- changing move.

moves.name: Secret Power
moves.description: An attack that may have an additional effect that varies with the terrain.

moves.name: Calm Mind
moves.description: The user focuses its mind to raise the SP. ATK and SP. DEF stats.

moves.name: Shock Wave
moves.description: A rapid jolt of electricity strikes the foe. It can’t be evaded.

moves.name: Mega Punch
moves.description: The foe is slugged by a punch thrown with muscle-packed power.

moves.name: Mega Kick
moves.description: The foe is attacked by a kick fired with muscle-packed power.

moves.name: Body Slam
moves.description: The user drops its full body on the foe. It may leave the foe paralyzed.

moves.name: Double-Edge
moves.description: A reckless, life- risking tackle that also hurts the user a little.

moves.name: Counter
moves.description: A retaliation move that counters any physical hit with double the damage.

moves.name: Seismic Toss
moves.description: A gravity-fed throw that causes damage matching the user’s level.

moves.name: Thunder Wave
moves.description: A weak electric shock that is sure to cause paralysis if it hits.

moves.name: Mimic
moves.description: The user copies the move last used by the foe for the rest of the battle.

moves.name: Metronome
moves.description: Waggles a finger and stimulates the brain into using any move at random.

moves.name: Dream Eater
moves.description: Absorbs half the damage it inflicted on a sleeping foe to restore HP.

moves.name: Substitute
moves.description: The user creates a decoy using one- quarter of its full HP.

moves.name: Hypnosis
moves.description: Hypnotic suggestion is used to make the foe fall into a deep sleep.

moves.name: Mimic
moves.description: The user copies the move last used by the foe for the rest of the battle.

moves.name: Psych Up
moves.description: The user hypnotizes itself into copying any stat change made by the foe.

moves.name: Future Sight
moves.description: Two turns after this move is used, the foe is attacked psychically.

moves.name: Fake Out
moves.description: An attack that hits first and causes flinching. Usable only on 1st turn.

moves.name: Trick
moves.description: A move that tricks the foe into trading held items with the user.
